# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-08-12 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- 08/12: Ravens signed QB Austin Reed (2024 UDFA, ex-UFL) after working out four quarterbacks; placed QB Skylar Thompson on injured reserve in a corresponding move, likely ending his season. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-sign-quarterback-austin-reed-skylar-thompson-training-camp)
- 08/11: CB Nate Wiggins was carted off Tuesday's practice, but after an MRI the Ravens believe he avoided a serious injury and expect him back "sooner rather than later," putting a spotlight on the team's CB depth. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7506774/2026/08/11/ravens-training-camp-nate-wiggins-injury/)
- 08/12: DT Nnamdi Madubuike continues progressing in his recovery from last season's neck injury; DC Anthony Weaver said, "When it's time, he'll be ready to go." [Russell Street Report](https://russellstreetreport.com/2026/08/12/tltakes/madubuike-ramps-up/)
- 08/12: CB Marlon Humphrey left Wednesday's practice early with the training staff, the Ravens' latest camp injury scare. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/marlon-humphrey-exits-early-ravens-cornerback-depth-practice-report-training-camp-2026)

## Injuries
- 08/12: CB Marlon Humphrey left practice early Wednesday with team medical staff after forcing a pass breakup; it wasn't clear what was bothering him. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/marlon-humphrey-exits-early-ravens-cornerback-depth-practice-report-training-camp-2026)

- 08/11: CB Nate Wiggins suffered no structural damage after being carted off during Tuesday's practice. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7506774/2026/08/11/ravens-training-camp-nate-wiggins-injury/)
